raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. body of laws, kanun: section 45 of the penal ~, seksyen 45 kanun jenayah; 2. system of principles, tata: ~ of behaviour, tatalaku; ~ of ethics, tataetika; moral ~, tatamoral; 3. system of secret words, letters, etc, kod: Morse ~, kod Morse; a message typed in ~, mesej yg ditaip dlm bentuk kod; 4. system of letters or numbers used for identification, kod: ~ number, nombor kod; post ~, poskod; dialling ~, kod mendail; exchange ~, kod ibu sawat; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
